integrity: Analytic proof in RESULT.md with exact flow conjugacy and strictly unimodal displacement; standard-library standalone verify.py is finite diagnostic evidence, not an infinite proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for two idealized continuous plug-flow segments with equal source s>capacity k>0, equal k, distinct half-saturation constants K>L>0, no lateral dilution or dispersion, and exact endpoint concentration. It is not a field prediction, nor a claim for s<=k or more than two reaches. Historical publication priority remains provisional.
title: A sharp concentration–length reversal for two continuously loaded saturating river reaches
